# OrionekoX

> OrionekoX is a local-first AI agent client for Android, forked from Telegram 13.0.3.
> It adds local agents, groups, MCP, skills, workspaces, terminal and workflows while
> keeping Telegram's native UI. GPL-2.0; modifications by the AI coding agent blancatora.

## Start here

- [README (Chinese)](README.md): what it is, features, build, compatibility roadmap.
- [README (English)](README.en.md): English equivalent.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how AI coding agents should build, test and modify this repo.

## Architecture

- [Ox bridge](TMessagesProj/src/main/java/org/telegram/ox/OxAgentsBridge.java): local agents, groups and media.
- [Agent store](TMessagesProj/src/main/java/org/telegram/ox/OxAgentStore.java): synthetic contacts and provider/model settings.
- [Group store](TMessagesProj/src/main/java/org/telegram/ox/OxGroupStore.java): local-only groups and per-group history.
- [Ox settings UI](TMessagesProj/src/main/java/org/telegram/ui/OxSettingsActivity.java): provider, tools, MCP, skills, terminal and workflow settings.
